==Description==
The '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Minigunner''' was a character figure that can be obtained from the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 9''. It was released on the 1st of March 2021. This toy is based on the third version of the Level 5 Default [[Minigunner]]. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''From Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 9'''
*:Now you can assemble the ultimate Roblox toy collection with these iconic characters from your favourite games! There are 24 new figures from Series 9 and each comes with a code for an exclusive virtual item that can be redeemed on Roblox. Collect them all! Each sold separately.
*''' From Jazewares website'''
*:This massive weapon will keep others guessing – is it for shooting water or busting ghosts? Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

==Prices & Stores==
The ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 9'' has 24 figures that may be included. As you cannot guarantee what toy you get from the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 9'', there is no fixed price for the '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Minigunner'''.

The rarity of this item is also unknown as each figure does not have the same rarity.

The costs and stores listed are for one purchase of the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 9'', unless stated otherwise. Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $3.99-$14.99 in the US, £3.99 in the UK and €4.99 in the EU. 

The stores in which you can buy the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 9'' depends on each country. The toy is subject to availability.

The following list is a selection of the online stores that you can buy this item from. This is not meant to be a comprehensible list:

*[https://www.amazon.com/Roblox-Action-Collection-Mystery-Exclusive/dp/B08FXS3MXR Amazon] (6-Pack, Worldwide)
*[https://www.walmart.com/ip/Roblox-Action-Collection-Series-9-Mystery-Figure-Includes-1-Figure-1-Exclusive-Virtual-Item/116511061 Walmart] (US, Canada & Mexico)

==Trivia==
*While based on the version 3 of the Level 5 Default Minigunner, the version 2 Level 5 {{Color|F3B05F|Blue}} and {{Color|F3B05F|Green}} skins use the same model as the Level 5 Default skin.
*The {{RLinkC|5122217789|Plasma Ray Back Gun}} accessory that comes with this figure is based on the laser minigun that the version 3 Level 5 Default [[Minigunner]] wields.
**It is not, however, the same model.
